title: Dangerous driving TikTok trend – level 1
paragraphs: Five young boys die in a car crash in Ireland. They steal a car. Then, they drive on the wrong side of a highway. They hit another car with a family inside. Four people in the family are in the hospital with bad injuries.
Police say that the teenagers drive fast and dangerously to make short videos for social media. They wanted to get likes and new friends online. Many young boys do it now.
The Irish government wants TikTok to stop these dangerous videos. TikTok says that it deletes bad videos and accounts which break safety rules.
